Frezine is a high-contrast pixelated condensed serif crafted for fashion labels, magazine editorial layouts, and tech-driven visual identities looking to blend classic elegance with a retro digital edge.

Perfect for magazine mastheads, editorial layouts, luxury tech packaging, music album art, and visual identity projects. Give your high class product and digital branding projects a bold, timeless edge with Frezine today!
